title: The Canon of the Layered Guard
summary: A canon teaching plate and forearm and shoulder as stacked layers of guard that each blow must break in turn.

title: Treatise on the Returned Cut
summary: A treatise on taking a cut square on the plate and sending its force back along the blade to the foe.

title: The Field-Backed Plate Manual
summary: A manual for holding the small shield inside a living qi field that thickens around it and bursts outward.

title: A Compendium of Breaking Strokes
summary: A compendium of strokes that open a foe's guard and bend or shatter the weapon held behind it.

title: The Twin-Hand Shield and Blade Course
summary: A course in which plate and blade answer one another along two qi tracks as a single paired guard.

title: Treatise on the Hawk's Wing Plate
summary: A treatise that likens the plate arm to a hawk's wing that spreads to cover and folds to stoop.

title: The Azure Basin Guard Canon
summary: A canon of the hollowed plate that gathers blows as a basin gathers water and pours them back.

title: The Dual-Track River Shield Manual
summary: A manual of the river's bend and current in two qi channels that turn blows and carry the plate onward.

title: The Wind-Sworn Plate Manual
summary: A manual of the plate held to the wind with a silent oath to hold the line against every blow.

title: Treatise on the Plateau Edge Guard
summary: A treatise on guarding a line as one guards a plateau's edge with the plate rim drawn along it.

title: The Oath of the Open Bearing
summary: A manual of advancing openly behind an unhidden plate on a held bearing with companions at the shoulder.

title: The Gale-Turning Shield Canon
summary: A canon of spinning the plate in a spiral of qi that draws blows in and throws them off.
